nodes.label: pnpm hoisted linker for RN tooling
nodes.rationale: React Native tooling (autolinking, CocoaPods, Gradle codegen) assumes a flat node_modules; pnpm's default isolated linker is a symlink farm that breaks it, so nodeLinker: hoisted with hoistingLimits: workspaces is used instead.

nodes.label: Exact React version pin across workspace
nodes.rationale: Duplicate React in one app is a runtime error, and a ^ range would let a future pnpm update split web and mobile apart; react-native's peerDependency (19.2.3) is the tighter constraint so it wins for both apps.

nodes.label: @livekit/react-native>@livekit/components-react pin
nodes.rationale: components-react's default resolution requires a livekit-client peer newer than what @elevenlabs/client pins exactly (2.16.1); 2.9.19 is the newest components-react release whose peer range still accepts it.

nodes.label: allowBuilds postinstall allow/deny list
nodes.rationale: pnpm 10+ blocks dependency postinstall scripts until named; esbuild/sharp/unrs-resolver are load-bearing and allowed to restore pnpm 9 behavior, while dtrace-provider and browser-tabs-lock are explicitly denied since one is an unused optional native probe and the other's postinstall is only a console.log on a platform adapter this iOS-only app never executes.
